Who We Are - Motivated by Purpose. Powered by Clinical Expertise. 




 Founded in 1983, we’re a clinically-driven, tech-enabled utilization management company offering expert clinical reviews, regulatory guidance, and actionable insights to healthcare organizations. 




 Excellence starts with our people. 




 WE OFFER 




 A competitive compensation package 


 Benefits include healthcare, vision, and dental insurance 


 A generous 401(k) match 


 Paid vacation, PTO, and holidays 


 Growth and training opportunities 


 An award-winning remote work environment 




 POSITION OVERVIEW 




 The Business Intelligence Analyst is a key corporate role at MRIoA, blending financial, analytical, and operational expertise. This position plays a critical role in driving the organization’s long-term success by delivering high-quality data insights and identifying opportunities where data can be leveraged to enhance performance, efficiency, and sustainable growth. 



Roles:


 Deliver strategic reporting and insights to the C-Suite, Executive Management team, and Board of Directors. 


 Partner with the business’s functional leaders to develop KPIs, provide ongoing reporting, and analyze the business impact of strategic initiatives. 



Major Responsibilities or Assigned Duties:

Business segmentation and reporting:


 Understand the key levers of the business and devise new ways to segment and analyze the business. 


 Provide regular updates to the Executive Team on progress towards goals as well as proactively identify insights and recommendations for improvement. 



KPI reporting and tracking:


 Work cross-functionally to develop and monitor key performance indicators. 


 Identify trends, outliers, and obscurities in the data and translate them into actionable insights for functional leaders. 



Board Reporting and Follow-up:


 Assist in the creation of Board of Directors presentations with the ability to analyze financial, commercial, and operational data. 


 Create simple and compelling visuals to demonstrate business performance, trends, and progress. 



Data Stewardship:


 Design and implement reporting solutions enabling stakeholders to manage the business and make effective decisions 


 Create and update dashboards that will power operational teams and decorate hallway monitors. 


 Foster transparency and dedication to continuous improvement throughout the Company by being a steward of the data-driven culture at MRIoA. 



Special Project Support:


 Participate in strategic initiatives to facilitate forecasting business impact and analyzing the results of pilots/ implementations. 


 Ad hoc data retrieval and analysis 



Requirements:


 Skills 




 Advanced Excel skills with the ability to utilize PowerQuery, PowerPivot, and VBA to support company reporting 


 Ability to synthesize and communicate data effectively (verbally and visually). 


 Knowledge and understanding of Power Apps and integrating usage into production environments 


 Fast learner with a passion for taking on challenges 


 Team player with the ability to work cross-functionally 


 Constantly curious to dig deeper and understand the “why” 


 Self-starter that excels in fast-paced, high-growth environments and does not need direct management 


 Advanced knowledge of Business Objects, SQL, and Microsoft Applications, including Excel 


 SQL/DBA experience and ability to pull data from reporting servers for analysis 



Experience:


 2+ years of statistical analysis or data analysis experience. 


 Experience working with modern data platforms and cloud analytics ecosystems (e.g., Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake), including data modeling, transformation, and analytical querying to support enterprise reporting and insights. 


 Experience building financial models and translating them into usable tools and simplified insights. 


 Experience with business intelligence (BI) and BI visualization tools required (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Domo). 


 Experience with private equity, venture capital, investment banking, management consulting, or a growth-stage healthcare or premium consumer business preferred. 



﻿Education:


 Bachelor’s Degree required 


 Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or Accounting preferred 







 :

 Ability to sit at a desk, utilize a computer, telephone, and other basic office equipment is required. This role is designed to be a remote position (work-from-home).

job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: The Business Intelligence and Systems Analyst supports various company categories and business functions across the Fuel & Energy Business by ensuring the proper reporting and data are available for internal users
This role involves extensive collaboration with internal customers and the IT team to provide comprehensive data analysis and reporting solutions
The Analyst will act as a point of contact for reporting needs, develop reporting tools, and create data models to identify business challenges and opportunities for improvement

The Business Intelligence and Systems Analyst plays a crucial role in driving the business forward through meticulous data analysis and reporting, ensuring that internal customers have access to accurate and actionable data

What You'll DoProvide research and reporting support to internal customers, including financial analysis, data analysis, trend identification, and monitoring and summarizing the progress of tests and promotions
Create reporting tools to identify business challenges and opportunities for improvement
Use data from various sources in reporting to drive the business forward in areas such as retail pricing, wholesale analysis, fuel accounting, etc
Fulfill ad hoc requests for reports determining fuel trends, fuel grade testing, exception reporting analysis, etc
Assess current company reporting processes and provide recommendations for new methods to enhance reporting and analytics for internal customers

Work with the Business Intelligence team on reporting and data efficiency, ensuring Power BI dashboards are up and refreshing appropriately for all business units supported.If reports are down, work with IT to get reports functioning appropriately
Collaborate with multiple business groups to gather requirements for requested reports and dashboards
This includes Retail Fuel Pricing, Gulf, Silver Comet, B2B Sales, RaceWay, Legal, and Energy Dispatch
Meet with IT members to locate, understand, and consume tables needed to create the requested reports and dashboards
Make recommendations to IT on different storage methodologies for data based on use cases
Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) on the data to understand its quirks for creating fit-for-purpose report data models
Using the located data, curate it for a fit-for-purpose report data model, including the creation of datasets, dataflows, data lakehouse storage objects, and other data models
Consume the data model into a data analysis tool, such as Power BI, and build the appropriate business calculations and visuals according to gathered requirements
Work with business units to UAT the report/dashboard to identify and resolve any issues
Complete all documentation around reports and maintain organized storage for all report/dashboard files
Work with vendors to obtain better/more accurate data files
Communicate with leadership and stakeholders on report/dashboard findings, development status, issues, and plans to resolve issues
